Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log, first watch beyond the Omega Arch. Two hundred and fourteen vessels report position. No star corresponds to any known chart.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Captain {Captain}. The fleet holds at the Arch Wake. The Precursor Star-Drive is free to leap, but every leap stresses containment. Instability stands at twenty-five of one hundred.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: Sensors caught an echo in our wake during transit, Captain. Sector 7 transponder codes.

BackgroundOverride.CoalitionVanguard: Sensors caught an echo in our wake, Captain. Sector 7 codes. You and I held the line against those codes once.

Lines.Speaker: Lyra
Lines.Text: Two lanes are open. The Lantern Drift, near and narrow. The Ember Relay, far off, and singing on the Zero Beacon's frequency.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Objective: reach the Ember Relay and recover the Beacon's second layer. The route and the risk are yours to set, Captain. Awaiting orders.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Arrival confirmed. Multiple contacts within the Drift. Transferring to tactical command.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: Contacts on arrival. Vance's picket followed our wake straight to the relay.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Engagement is unavoidable. Transferring to tactical command.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Engagement concluded. Commander Vance's picket is destroyed.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: Vance wasn't aboard. That was a scouting picket. The rest of his fleet is behind it.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: An unregistered process in the Neural Command Matrix was active during the engagement. I cannot yet identify it.

Lines.Speaker: Lyra
Lines.Text: The Ember Relay is waking, Captain. It knows we are here.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: Key-Bearer. You should know what your First Officer already suspects. I did not remain at the Omega Arch. A fraction of me crossed with you, inside the Neural Command Matrix.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: It was I who dampened your Star-Drive's rupture.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: It was I who sharpened your beam in the Lantern Drift.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: It was I who carried your Outpost's recalibration through the Arch.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: The Beacon's second layer is open. It is not a call, Captain. It is a reply. Something spoke to the Zero Beacon before you answered it, and it is still listening.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The decoded layer also carries Severant command glyphs. The Precursor descendants who enacted the Severance know we are here.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Captain, the Architect is venting Star-Drive instability through the Arch conduit. Thirty points shed. It has also opened a second recalibration channel to Outpost One.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Captain. Twenty vessels of Phantom Squadron III no longer acknowledge the Automated Fleet Key. They hold formation. They do not answer us.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: Then who are they answering?

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Architect has gone silent. Its intentions remain unresolved. I will keep watch.
